newsitem.title: FRANCE: SEB drops as sales rise disappoints.
newsitem.headline: SEB drops as sales rise disappoints.

text.p: Shares in domestic appliances maker SEB SA fell on Thursday as investors judged a rise in first half profits disappointing.
SEB on Wednesday said it first half sales rose 17 percent to 5.125 billion francs and said that on a like-for-like basis the figure was up 13 percent.
SEB shares were down 4.53 percent at 1,074 francs at 0829 GMT, making it the biggest faller in the morning.
"The rise was less pronounced than in recent years and sales in Europe were down while Europe is their main market," a broker said. "There remains a need for further restructuring," he added.
